correctness.rationale: Exact conic equation and projective Fermat normalization yield one irreducible center and exactly 3p cusps; the regular coordinates A=X^p-1-Z^p, B=Z give A²-4B^p+epsilon(1+A+3B^p+AB^p+B^{2p})=0. Weighted base-change epsilon=s^{2p}, A=s^p a, B=s² b yields smooth hyperelliptic tail a²=4b^p-1 with one infinity; toric resolutions produce only unstable rational chains, leaving one stable tail per cusp. Genus reconciliation ensures completeness; the star is compact type. Deck monodromy on H^{1,0} of each tail has eigenvalues -zeta_p^k (k=1,...,(p-1)/2), with conjugates covering k=1,...,p-1, giving Phi_{2p} per tail and exact 2p order. Embedded SymPy script actually replayed successfully; it supplements rather than proves the global geometric step.

value.rationale: The previously identified nonstable t=-2 boundary of a naturally defined and recently studied infinite family is replaced by a full explicit Deligne-Mumford stable curve with central Fermat normalization, 3p identical positive-genus hyperelliptic tails, exact graph, product of component Jacobians, and full finite-order monodromy spectrum. This is a structural boundary classification of all primes p>=5 and materially refines the known nonstability observation; the precise boundary invariant is motivated by compactification and degeneration of Jacobians.
